text.div:
SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD

  • Review the levodopa dose and timing at every visit for slowness, wearing-off, and dyskinesia; take doses 30 minutes before meals; check supine and three-minute standing blood pressure after any change; avoid dopamine-blocking drugs such as metoclopramide, prochlorperazine, and most antipsychotics
  • Movement disorders neurology consultation to confirm the diagnosis against the MDS criteria, adjust levodopa, plan rehabilitation, and advise on genetic testing
  • Four-week intensive speech therapy (LSVT LOUD) for soft speech, and physical therapy for gait, balance, and a home exercise program of at least 150 minutes a week
  • Monitor on the CMID schedule: motor examination, Hoehn and Yahr stage, fall check, psychosis and impulse-control questions, and medication review every visit; cognition, mood, sleep, autonomic symptoms, swallowing, speech, and driving yearly; dental examination every six months
  • Advance care planning: name a health care agent and record goals of care, and revisit with any change in stage

resource.title: Muhammad Ali synthetic care plan
resource.description: Long-term care of a man with young-onset Parkinson's disease twelve years after diagnosis: a structured motor examination and Hoehn and Yahr stage at every visit; levodopa dose and timing adjusted for bradykinesia with supine and standing blood pressure checks; screening for falls, swallowing problems, mood, cognition, sleep, autonomic symptoms, psychosis, and impulse control; speech therapy for soft speech and physical therapy for gait and balance; avoidance of dopamine-blocking drugs; and advance care planning, on the CMID Parkinson's disease schedule with AAN and MDS guidance. The publicly discussed link to boxing is treated as a disputed retrospective interpretation, not a diagnosis.
